jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM Dasmariñas
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This position will be reporting to work at SM Dasmariñas. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. jobs.title: Cashier, SM Nuvali
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work at SM Nuvali. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: Financial Analyst & General Accountant
jobs.description: The Financial Analyst and General Accountant ensures the accuracy and integrity of WTI’s financial records by recording transactions, analyzing financial data, and preparing timely reports to support management decisions. The role also ensures tax compliance with government regulations and collaborates with the Finance Manager in implementing and maintaining effective internal controls within the Finance function. General Ledger Management & Financial Reporting Maintain accurate general ledger records in accordance with PAS. Reconcile accounts, investigate discrepancies, and prepare financial statements and regular reports. Assist in budget preparation, cash advance liquidation review, and financial reporting improvements. Tax & Regulatory Compliance Ensure timely submission of tax returns and government reportorial requirements. Internal Controls & Audit Support Help improve internal control processes and coordinate with external auditors for annual audits. Accounting System Administration Maintain and manage the company’s accounting system (QNE).

jobs.title: Event Set Up Manager for Luzon and VisMin
jobs.description: Openings: 1 for Luzon; 1 for Visayas and Mindanao (VisMin) Department: Production & Fabrication Reports to: Fabrication Lead Work arrangement: Field-based, with frequent travel and overnight or early-morning work during event ingress Role purpose The Setup Manager leads the on-site build and ingress of events in their assigned region. They coordinate crews, suppliers, equipment, and schedules so that the venue is set up safely, correctly, and on time, and is ready for client inspection and event operations. Key responsibilities Lead on-site ingress, setup, strike, and turnover for assigned events. Turn approved plans, drawings, and schedules into a practical setup sequence, including crew assignments and equipment needs. Coordinate with production, project or account teams, suppliers, venue personnel, and other contractors. Brief and supervise setup crews; monitor attendance, work quality, conduct, and progress. Check that staging, structures, signage, furniture, technical equipment, and other event elements match approved specifications. Monitor timelines and resolve on-site issues, escalating scope, cost, safety, or schedule concerns promptly. Enforce venue rules and company safety procedures; report hazards, incidents, and damage. Keep clear records of setup progress, labor and equipment use, issues, and client or venue approvals. Ensure the site is clean, organized, and ready for handover; oversee strike and the return of equipment after the event. Build and maintain working relationships with reliable local crews and suppliers in the assigned region. Travel within the assigned region and support events in other regions when required.
